propositions: Five prose upgrades to implement-side skill and test-design documentation target build-time parity siblings, config read-but-miswired, op-level contention semantics, gate findings without oracle upgrades, and known residual gaps at close.
Surface-parity census (4a) must enumerate five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) with in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-reason disposition.
Test-design §6 config-effect contrast requires per-config-key tests proving behavioral change through real read paths (default vs non-default), not just value parsing.
Contention triggers (case c) must route by shape to existing shared suites: composed check-then-act writes to two_clones, write-storm/retry to storm suite, read-integrity to sync_contention_harness.
Behavioral gate findings require RED test first in the same change before fix; non-behavioral findings fixed directly without change-detector exemption.
Phase 5 residual-gap disposition sweep over enumerable source checklist with items filed/accepted/fixed or marked none.
